in_marathi.name: Shanmugam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shanmugam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who brings victory and protects. God of war and protection. Derived from the Sanskrit name Shana-Mukha, meaning 'God with ten faces'.

in_bengali.name: Shanmugam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shanmugam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who brings victory and protects. God of war and protection. Derived from the Sanskrit name Shana-Mukha, meaning 'God with ten faces'.
